# EMA Language Translation from Vault

## Main point
A lot of the old vault's useful structure should survive, but the language should shift.

## Old language -> EMA language
- vault -> shared workspace
- note -> page / object page / artifact / capture
- Obsidian graph -> EMA graph / workspace graph
- session memory file -> chronicle / recall / memory object
- agent knowledge -> shared knowledge / imported capability / reference
- system note -> canon / host reality / implementation note
- hub/MOC -> hub / index / launchpad / graph entrypoint
- daily note -> daily capture / log / chronicle segment
- inbox -> capture inbox

## Why this matters
Language shapes architecture.
If EMA keeps talking like a notes vault, it will drift toward being a notes vault.
If it talks like a shared workspace with graph truth and live bindings, the product identity gets much cleaner.

## Rule
Translate the old vault's mechanisms forward, but do not let its vocabulary constrain EMA's identity.
